cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 64 since November 2022. Graduate of Robertsdale High School and the University of Mobile (listed as Mobile College on Ballotpedia). Career includes work with Baldwin EMC. Has chaired the North Baldwin and Central Baldwin Chambers of Commerce.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Donna Givens was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We could not find her specific job title or years at Baldwin EMC, or any other employment history. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, so we found no statements of her positions on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. The pages we had did not show the content of her sponsored bills, so we could not confirm any specific legislative action on these topics. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or endorsements.
